t1.summary:
I wrote the triage decisions document (533 lines). All 200 request rows have a verdict: 31 accepted as patch, 34 as minor, 0 as major, 14 deferred, 10 rejected, and 111 treated as document-internal with propagation instructions. The input list's "bible section" column mostly points to the source document's own section, so I judged each row on its content, and more than half turned out not to need a bible change. The counts above are per amendment item: 25 patch items (AM-01~25), 19 minor items (AM-26~44), 12 deferred items (AM-45~56), 10 rejections (R-01~10).

Because at least one minor was accepted, the bible target is 1.3.0 and the brief moves to v1.2.2 (document map patch only). No major was accepted. The two changes M1 actually needs can be written as additions:
- AM-26: widen `requires_lineage` so `chunk` can read `ParsedDocument` (the default `structure_aware` chunker needs its structure fields).
- AM-27: optional `StageContext.plan` and `artifacts` members.

The main decisions are:
- **FR-MGT-01**: satisfied by adding the `/v1/tenants` endpoints (quotas and deactivation) plus API keys, plugins, schemas list, version, audit events, profiles, unmask and consistency-check to bible §14 (AM-39), with `TenantStatus` and `tenant.policies.changed` (AM-38).
- **Catalogue additions**: 16 error codes (AM-36), `JobKind.delete_collection` and `collection.delete.v1` (AM-37), common-types promotion of shared subtypes (AM-35), optional fields on `StageError`/`ProblemDetails`, `RankedResult` and `NormalizedDocument`, and cache-key fixes in §6.2 (AM-40).
- **Completeness review**: management API DTOs stay API-only views (AM-02). Traceability uses the machine-generated 06 matrix. The CLI's canonical section goes in 10-development/02.
- **Deferred to ADR-0039+**: reindex mode B and green physical naming get open-decision numbers O-11 and O-12 (AM-21) but are deferred (AM-45). Also deferred: the `cancelling → succeeded` transition (with an interim rule written down), field renames and constraint tightening, and default-value changes still waiting on gate evidence.
- **Contract audit (47 decisions)**: section 6.2 maps each one to either an AM item or the documents it must be propagated to.

Contracts are affected (contracts_affected=true): the changes add enums and optional fields to common-types and five contract schemas, with no removals, renames or new required fields. I decided `schema_version` stays at 1.0.0 because these changes land before M1, and M1 is when 1.0.0 starts. T3 applies the schema changes and must get ERROR 0 from `validate-contracts.mjs`.

I did not edit the bible, brief, contracts or schemas, so I did not run the validator. Relative links in the new document point to files that exist.

t2.summary:
The bible, the brief and the propagation directives are all done. The contract validator currently reports one ERROR: `JobKind` is missing `delete_collection` in common-types. It clears once T3 adds that value, as AM-37 requires. I did not edit any schema. Everything else passes, except two pre-existing WARNs about 03-contracts/09 schema blocks being out of sync.

**Bible (docs/02-architecture/00-design-bible.md, 1.2.1 → 1.3.0):**
- Applied all AM-01~AM-44 as local edits. The AM-15 location (§7.3) was already correct in 1.2.1, so there was nothing to change for it.
- §5.1 inventory: added the `SchemaDiffReport` row (35 types) and a footnote making management API DTOs API-only views.
- Changed sections: §1.2, §2.2, §3.2 (O-11 and O-12 registered as open), §3.3 (ADR-0039 row), §4.1~4.4, §5.3~5.7 (`TenantStatus`, `CompatLevel`/`SchemaChangeKind`, `JobKind.delete_collection`, `tenant.policies.changed`, 16 new error codes), §6.1/6.2/6.5/6.7, §7.1/7.3, §8.1, §9.5, §10.1/10.3, §11.2/11.4, §12, §13.1/13.3, §14.
- Added a 1.3.0 entry to the change history in the scope section, a v1.3.0 change table keyed by AM number under the decision summary, and five new items to the open-issues section (18~22). Closed open issue 11.
- §16 is unchanged.

**Things I decided on my own:**
- The additive bundle takes ADR-0039. The release-versioning ADR that other docs had pencilled in as 0039 moves to 0040 or later.
- I also registered `CompatLevel` and `SchemaChangeKind` in §5.7 alongside `SchemaDiffReport`. AM-01 did not explicitly list them.
- I added `schema_version` 1.0.0 is kept, since no contract has shipped yet (before M1).

**Brief (docs/00-vision/00-design-brief.md, 1.2.1 → 1.2.2):**
- The §8 document map now matches the actual files: 07-tech-landscape 00~14, 12-appendix 02~08, the 06-adr README, openapi.yaml, 35 schema files and `schemas/README.md` (planned).
- Added an O-11/O-12 note under §5, as AM-21 requires.
- §4 is unchanged because no D-xx decision was amended, so the version stays at 1.2.2.

**Propagation directives:** 93 documents, 525 checklist items, each with 3~15 items. That is more than the 40~70 you expected because every 03-contracts document, 8 ADRs and openapi.yaml are included. Schema changes are marked `[T3]` for the contracts agent.

**Things to know before the next step:**
- ADR-0039 is now cited in the bible, the brief and the directives, but the file does not exist yet, so the doc audit's A7 citation check will flag it until it is written. The 06-adr/README section of the directives covers writing it.
- The audit's A2 report of missing frontmatter in 01-requirements/03 is wrong. The file has frontmatter; the auditor fails on its CRLF line endings. I rewrote that directive to say so.

t3.audit_summary: 바이블 v1.3.0 채택 항목(트리아지 §2.1/§2.2) 중 계약·스키마에 영향을 주는 AM-10·26·28~44 및 계약 감사 정본 결정(CR-01~47) 가운데 T3(스키마 담당) 태그 항목, 그리고 전파 지시서 03-contracts/* 절의 [T3] 표시 항목을 schemas/*.schema.json과 03-contracts/*.md의 '## 스키마' 블록·필드 표에 반영했다. 시작 시점에 이미 ERROR 1(JobKind 열거 불일치)·WARN 2(09 문서 스키마 블록 비동기화)였고, 이번 작업으로 ERROR 0/WARN 0을 달성했다(node tools/validate-contracts.mjs --root . 로 여러 차례 재검증, 최대 4회 한도 내에서 안정적으로 0 유지). 주요 변경: (1) schemas/common-types.schema.json — JobKind에 delete_collection(AM-37), EventType에 tenant.policies.changed(AM-38, 24→25종), ErrorCodeCatalog에 16종 추가(AM-36, 68→84종), TenantStatus 신설(AM-38), RankedResult에 token_count_primary·ordinal·text_truncated·pii_policy_applied 추가(AM-33), EgressPolicy에 strip_query_keys 추가(AM-30), 공용 타입 9종 승격(SecurityFilter·StrategyFilter·ChannelRunId·EmbeddingSpaceIds·TableRef·ProfileId·AnalyzerId·KebabName·ContractsCompat, AM-35) 및 Capabilities.contracts_compat을 그 $ref로 전환. (2) 승격에 따라 candidate-set·context-pack·query-plan·ranked-set·collection-spec·embedded-chunk-set·index-commit·index-record·chunk-set·normalized-document·schema-diff-report·plugin-meta의 로컬 $defs 사본을 삭제하고 common-types $ref로 전환(교차 참조 잔존 없음 확인). (3) CR-09에 따라 03~08 계약 스키마(normalized-document·chunk-set·enriched-chunk-set·embedded-chunk-set·index-commit·index-record) schema_version에 1.x 패턴 제약 추가. (4) 개별 필드 추가: profile.schema.json에 profile_hash(readOnly, AM-34)·PiiConfig.reject_entities(AM-43), enriched-chunk-set.schema.json에 BudgetUsed.charged_tokens(AM-32), cloud-event-envelope.schema.json의 IndexConsistencyMismatchData에 kind·observed_generations(요청#172, 트리아지 T3 지정), job-status.schema.json의 idempotency_key를 nullable로 완화(AM-44 배치 자식 잡 대응). (5) 원래 WARN 원인이었던 query-request/query-plan 스키마의 글로서리 접두 오기(§16 G-08 → GL-08, D4-1 누락분)를 정정. (6) 해당 12개 03-contracts 문서의 '## 스키마' JSON 블록을 실제 schemas/*.json과 동일하게 재동기화하고(deepEq 기준), 06·10·15 문서의 필드 표에 새 선택 필드 행(charged_tokens, token_count_primary/ordinal/text_truncated/pii_policy_applied, profile_hash, reject_entities, strip_query_keys)을 추가했으며, 15 문서 '## 미해결 이슈' 13행을 공용 타입 승격 완료로 갱신하고, 00 문서의 common-types 요약 문구($defs 개수)를 현행화했다. 12개 03-contracts 문서 frontmatter version을 patch 증가시키고 last_updated를 2026-09-23으로 갱신했다(status는 active 유지, ADR 없음). 스키마 파일 12종은 파일 전체를 JSON.stringify(2-space)로 재직렬화했으므로(원래는 leaf 객체를 한 줄로 압축하는 커스텀 포맷이었음) 포맷 스타일이 달라졌지만 내용은 동치(파서 검증 통과, $ref 전부 해결 확인)이다.
